prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1315; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you reported. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were when the accident happened.

A: I was driving on the highway in Conroe, Texas, heading toward the north side of town. I was in the right lane.

Q: Can you describe what you were doing right before the collision?

A: I was changing lanes to move into the left lane because the traffic in front of me had slowed down. I checked my mirror and it looked clear, so I started to move over.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?

A: Not until it was right beside me. I felt a bump and heard a loud scrape along my driver side. The other car was already alongside me when I noticed it.

Q: Were you able to stop after the contact?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder as soon as I could. I stayed in my vehicle for a minute because my right shoulder was hurting pretty badly from gripping the wheel and turning.

Q: Did you receive any medical attention?

A: Yes, a paramedic checked me at the scene, and I went to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon. They said I had a shoulder strain and gave me a sling and some medication.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement in the shoulder?

A: Yes, I still have pain when I lift my arm above my head, and I am not able to do my normal work lifting tasks right now.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you would like to add about the collision?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to make sure my statement is accurate.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
